concerns.text: T013 (merge_and_buffer.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012.5 (select_top_species.py), T012 (download_nlcd), and T008b (generate_guild_mapping). A task cannot be parallel-safe if it consumes artifacts produced by other tasks in the same phase. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect and misleading for execution planning.

T012.6 (stream_nlcd_tiles.py) is marked [P] but depends on T012 (download_nlcd) and T012.1 (download_nlcd_fallback). Streaming logic cannot execute before the data is downloaded. The [P] tag violates the producer-consumer dependency rule.

T017 (extract_top_species.py) is marked [P] but depends on T012.5 (select_top_species.py) and T016 (aggregate.py). It reads the output of T012.5 (`top_25_species_ids.json`) and T016 (`species_profiles.csv`). Marking it [P] implies it can run in parallel with its producers, which is impossible.

T020.1 and T020.2 are marked [P] but depend on T019 (train.py) and T020 (evaluate.py) logic. T020.2 specifically validates the permutation method used in T020. These tasks cannot run in parallel with the training/evaluation they validate. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T025, T026, T027a-c, T028, T028.5 are all marked [P] but depend on T019 (model), T020 (evaluation), and T017 (species list). Visualization tasks cannot run in parallel with the model training and evaluation that generate their inputs. The [P] tag is semantically invalid.

T015 (validate_schema) and T010 (validate schema compliance) are marked [P] but depend on T013 (merge_and_buffer.py) which produces the `merged_observations.csv`. Validation tasks cannot run in parallel with the data generation they validate.
T016 (aggregate.py) is marked [P] but depends on T013 (merge_and_buffer.py). Aggregation cannot occur before merging. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T018 (Unit test for metric calculations) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (evaluate.py) which produces the metrics. Tests cannot run in parallel with the code they test if they require the output artifacts.

T007.5 (Implement run_pipeline.sh) is marked [P] but depends on the existence of all downstream scripts (T011, T012, T013, etc.) to be implemented. While the script skeleton can be written early, the task description implies implementing the full orchestration logic which requires the consumer scripts to exist. If interpreted as 'skeleton', it should be clarified; if 'full implementation', it cannot be [P].
T008b (generate_guild_mapping.py) is marked [P] but depends on T008a (download_guild_source.py). The mapping generation cannot run before the source data is downloaded. The [P] tag is incorrect.
